title: Jobs
description: Status of every job moving through @gnldev/queue — queued, running, completed, or dead-letter; retry requeues a dead-letter job under its original payload.
emptyDescription: Jobs appear once your app enqueues background work with @gnldev/queue's enqueue() — Studio can view and retry them here, not create them.
retryTitle: Requeue this job with its original payload
